result.body: You can request a new link from the sign-in page by selecting "Forgot password" [access-1]. Once received, be sure to open only the newest email [access-1].

To resolve this issue, please have a workspace admin open Settings > Integrations > Slack and select Reconnect [integrations-1]. Next, confirm the destination channel and send a test notification [integrations-1]. If the test fails, please share the error message so it can be routed to Technical Support [integrations-1].
If an invitation has expired, a workspace admin can resend it directly from the People screen [access-2].
To check your profile time zone, go to Profile > Preferences > Time zone [onboarding-2].

To assist with a duplicate charge or refund request, please provide the invoice ID and charge date so it can be sent to the Billing queue, where a billing specialist will review eligibility [billing-2].
If your export has failed twice, please send the project ID and approximate task count to Technical Support [integrations-2]. Do not attach confidential task contents [integrations-2].

To save a project template, create a project, add your standard task list, and select "Save as template" from the project menu [onboarding-1]. As a workspace admin, you can then make the template available to the entire workspace [onboarding-1].

For a service outage affecting multiple users, please collect the affected workspace ID, the approximate start time, and any visible errors [incidents-1]. Once gathered, this should be routed to Technical Support with critical urgency [incidents-1].

Workspace owners can download monthly invoice PDFs by going to Settings > Billing > Invoices, selecting the relevant billing month, and choosing Download PDF [billing-1]. If you do not have the owner role, you will need to ask your workspace owner to download the invoice for you [billing-1].
